chunks: Zurarah ibn A'yan asked Abā Ja'far and Abā 'Abdillāh, peace be upon them, about what nullifies wudu (ablution), so they said:
Whatever exits from your two lower openings, the front and the back, of excrement, urine, semen, or wind, and sleep until it takes away the intellect.

key_terms.النَّوْمُ: sleep, when it causes loss of awareness
key_terms.اَلْوُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing for worship
key_terms.يَنْقُضُ: nullifies or breaks in legal context

ai.seo_question: What things nullify wudu (ablution) in this hadith from Imam al-Baqir and Imam al-Sadiq عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the things that nullify wudu (ablution). It identifies bodily discharges from the two lower passages and sleep that removes awareness as invalidators of ritual purity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.137 - Zurarah ibn A'yan asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) and Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about what nullifies wudu (ablution).

They said: "Anything that exits from your two lower openings, the front (urethra) and the back (anus), such as excrement, urine, semen, or wind, as well as sleep that causes a loss of consciousness, invalidates wudu”.
